seat.note: President Emmanuel Macron cannot run for a third consecutive term.

nomineesSource: Candidacies are not final: the official list follows the Constitutional Council's validation of 500 sponsorships in early 2027. Listed here: declared candidates leading the polls and in coverage of AI policy, as of Nov. 2026, plus Jordan Bardella as the RN's alternate.

candidates.name: Marine Le Pen
candidates.note: Declared RN candidate (July 7, 2026). Her appeal to the Court of Cassation is pending: hearing Dec. 16, 2026, ruling expected by early April 2027. If she is barred, Jordan Bardella runs.

candidates.name: Jordan Bardella
candidates.note: RN president; the party's candidate only if the Court of Cassation bars Marine Le Pen. Slated to be her prime minister.

contextNotes.text: First round Sunday, April 18, 2027; second round (runoff between the top two) Sunday, May 2, 2027. The official campaign opens April 5, 2027.

On July 7, 2026 the Paris appeals court cut Marine Le Pen's ineligibility to a period that lets her run in 2027, and she declared her candidacy the same day. Her appeal to the Court of Cassation is pending (hearing Dec. 16, 2026; ruling expected by early April 2027). Jordan Bardella, RN president, would run if she cannot.

source.title: Eunews: Le Pen convicted on appeal, 45-month ineligibility, but she can still run in 2027
